description: ABSTRACT     "Holy Birth Week" tradition was initiated by the Directorate of Religious Affairs in Turkey in 1989. This event was organized under the name of "Mevlid Kandili", which commemorates the birth of the Prophet Muhammad in Ottoman society for centuries, and "Mevlid" was read in mosques to mark the birthday of the Prophet. However, the event was complicated by an atmosphere of mourning for years, not with the joy of Muhammad's birth. When this tradition first became official in 1989, it has been the subject of various comments and criticisms. It is possible that this tradition started as a competition and a challenge to the Christmas tradition of Jesus Christ, which is celebrated in Christendom on December 25. This tradition is one of the hundreds of signs of an ongoing identity crisis throughout history. Turks have felt the pain of the search for identity, especially throughout the history of the republic. Venhar.com asked me to write an article on this topic a few years ago. I wrote the following text on this request. Later, on April 18, 2014, the article was published on the site. See, http://venharhaber.com/?s=Kutlu+Do%C4%9Fum

creator: Open Journal for Educational Research (OJER)
description: The aim of present study is to examine the intellectual structure of the reference lists of postgraduate theses on mobile learning in Turkey. In this research, 88 postgraduate theses indexed in the National Thesis Center of the Council of Higher Education were examined. According to the obtained findings, it was determined that the most theses were conducted in 2019. The average number of pages and citations of doctoral theses is higher than that of master’s theses. The supervisors of the master’s theses are mostly Assistant professors while the advisors of doctoral theses are mostly Associate professors and Professors. In both master’s and doctoral theses, citations to journal articles are more common. The most cited journals in master’s theses were Computers and Education, Turkish Online Journal of Educational Technology, British Journal of Educational Technology. The most cited journals in doctoral theses were Computers and Education and British Journal of Educational Technology. Agnes Kukulska-Hulme and John Traxler’s book Mobile Learning: A Handbook for Educators and Trainers is the most cited book in master's theses. Mohamed Ally’s book Mobile Learning: Transforming the Delivery of Education and Training comes first in doctoral dissertations. description: Lysistrata, Aristofanes tarafından MÖ 411 yılında yazılmış, tek perdelik, seyirlik bir oyundur. İlk defa MÖ 411 baharında sahnelendiği düşünülen oyun, tiyatro tarihinin ilk savaş karşıtı oyunlarından birisi kabul edilir. Erkeklerinin savaştan dönmelerini beklemekten usanan kadınların savaşa son vermek için farklı savaşa bitene kadar erkeklerle yataklarını paylaşmamak kararı almaları ile gelişen olayları konu alır. Aristophanes'in üçüncü oyunudur. Yazarın en iyi kurulmuş, en insani komedyası olarak bilinen oyun, dünyanın birçok ülkesinde yüzlerce tiyatro topluluğu tarafından sahnelenmiştir. Eser, 1983’te Türkiye'de başrolünü Şener Şen'in oynadığı Şalvar Davası adlı filmle sinemaya, 1987’de Alman çizer Ralf König tarafından çizgi filme, 2005’te Amerikalı besteci Mark Adamo tarafından 2005’te operaya uyarlanmıştır.

creator: Dante Alghieri,Rekin Teksoy
description: TURK: Bu eser, İtalyan şair Dante Alighieri’nin 14. yüzyılın başında kaleme aldığı, Cehennem, Araf ve Cennet’e yapılan düşsel yolculuğu konu edinen 14.233 dizelik epik destanın Türkçe çevirisidir. Metin, Türkiye'deki önceki nesir (düz yazı) denemelerinin aksine, Türkçe literatürde ilk kez aslına uygun şekilde şiir formatında (manzum olarak) ve eksiksiz şekilde Rekin Teksoy tarafından Türkçeleştirilmiştir. Çeviride İtalyanca orijinal metnin yanı sıra tarihsel, mitolojik ve teolojik arka planı açıklayan kapsamlı dipnotlara yer verilmiştir. Eseri Türkçeye kazandıran yazar ve çevirmen Rekin Teksoy, bu çalışmasıyla İtalyan Senatosu Çeviri Ödülü 'ne layık görülmüştür. Teksoy'un kariyeri boyunca aldığı diğer resmi ödüller ve nişanlar şunlardır: Boccaccio'nun Decameron eserini ilk kez eksiksiz olarak Türkçeye çevirmesi nedeniyle İtalya Cumhurbaşkanı tarafından verilen Kültür Şövalyesi (Ordine della Stella della Solidarietà Italiana) unvanı, Carlo Goldoni'den çevirdiği İki Efendinin Uşağı oyunu ile Avni Dilligil En İyi Çeviri Ödülü , Sinema ve edebiyat alanındaki çalışmalarıyla Sadri Alışık Sinema Onur Ödülü ile Çeviri Derneği Onur Ödülü . ENG: This work is the Turkish translation of Italian poet Dante Alighieri’s early 14th-century epic masterpiece, which chronicles a visionary journey through Inferno, Purgatorio, and Paradiso across 14,233 lines. Diverging from previous Turkish prose adaptations, this edition represents the first complete translation into Turkish composed strictly in verse format , executed by Rekin Teksoy. The translation incorporates extensive annotations based on the original Italian text to contextualize its complex historical, mythological, and theological references. For his verse translation of this masterpiece, Rekin Teksoy was awarded the Translation Prize by the Italian Senate . His other official lifetime achievements, awards, and decorations include: The title of Knight of the Order of the Italian Star , bestowed by the President of Italy for executing the first complete Turkish translation of Boccaccio's Decameron , The Avni Dilligil Best Translation Award for his translation of Carlo Goldoni's play The Servant of Two Masters , The Sadri Alışık Cinema Honor Award and the Translation Association Honor Award for his extensive contributions to film history and literature.
